description.en: RSS reader for DeepSeek Harness: custom RSS/Atom subscriptions with OPML import/export, self-hosted FreshRSS account sync over the Google Reader API (read/star written back), and BYOK AI summary/translate/Q&A against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Ships DSH agent tools rss_recent_digest / rss_article_digest.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS 阅读器插件：自定义 RSS/Atom 订阅（OPML 导入导出）、自托管 FreshRSS 账号同步（Google Reader API，已读/收藏双向写回）、自带 Key 的 AI 摘要/翻译/单篇问答（OpenAI 兼容接口）。附带 rss_recent_digest / rss_article_digest 两个模型工具。
